name: Creator
description: High-energy portfolio for content creators, artists, and digital storytellers — social stats, content showcase, brand collaborations, and audience engagement metrics front and center.
designNotes: The Creator template is built on the 'Social Pulse' identity — a warm eggshell (#F1EDDC) canvas with Dartmouth-emerald, sunshade-orange, valentine-coral and bright-ube accents, the palette social brands actually use. Social stats (followers, views, engagement) lead as a clean four-up grid. Selected work renders as full-bleed photo cards with a duotone gradient + monogram fallback so it never breaks on slow mobile or before images load. Milestones and awards become pastel colour-block badges, and collaborator names scroll in an infinite marquee. Plus Jakarta Sans brings friendly, confident headlines over Inter body text. Mirrors the approved playable demo at /demo/creator (Skip-to-the-work view).
